item.title: Show HN: DevSnoop
item.summary: Yes, it's implemented with a coding agent. But I use it day to day and I think it's great. I originally built it because I wanted to be able to see the agent working in Chrome instead of in headless mode and share cookies easily (since it's the same session/instance). Sometimes I'd take over or it'd take over from me. I prefer it to DevTools MCP and Playwright. Comments URL: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=49269203 Points: 1 # Comments: 0
